answer: Identity certificates are minted only in a public forge that issues one non-transferable jade seal per funded session and binds a 12-hour key-locked liveness transcript into the seal. Renewal is allowed solely during a 20-minute jetty window each epoch, which admits at most one seal from any cluster sharing a payer, host, or mixer output. A second seal from that cluster is rejected and the 2,400 POA bond, frozen for 11 epochs, is slashed. One hundred aliases therefore need one hundred isolated 12-hour sessions and 240,000 POA left idle; one colliding transcript burns every linked seal.
